rows.en: Captain Sawa, how do things look on your end?
Chief Kitakura has been injured! She's being taken to the TDF hospital right now.

What!? Chief Kitakura?

So is she going to be all right? Chief Kitakura…?

I'm sorry, but…

I'm not a doctor! I can't tell you whether she'll live or die.
Chief Kitakura…

The last thing Chief Kitakura said was "One-Seven"…

Father…
Mm, I can't believe it, but…

Uuugh… What happened to me?

Oh, right… I lost my footing on the cliff and fell!

A… a robot…?

I get it, you're Saburo's… You saved me, didn't you? Thanks.
Officer Minami here! The campground has been attacked by Gigants.

What!?

What about Rumi? Is Rumi all right?
She's fine! She has excellent bodyguards with her…
Bodyguards?
[HERO4] and [HERO2]. I asked them to go.
[HERO4] and [HERO2]. I asked them to go.
I see…
More importantly… if the Naager attacked, then a new Brain Robot…?

Mm… Lately Brain has formed a united front with the Naager.

It's not impossible, but…

No… It was One-Seven that attacked Chief Kitakura!

Chief Kitakura kept saying it over and over in her delirium in the hospital room…
One-Seven is indeed a robot built by Brain… but surely that can't be?
Do you have any clear proof?
Take that up with Chief Kitakura! If you're saying she's lying, that's another story, but…
But… she could have been mistaken, couldn't she?
Dr. Sahara… Give the order to destroy One-Seven!
No, but…
Saburo… Go to One-Seven right away and check on it!
Huh…? Did something happen?
I'll explain later… Just hurry and find out where One-Seven is!
Roger!
BRAIN ROBOT? WHO ARE YOU!?
ONE-SEVEN… BROTHER…

…!?

WHAT DO YOU MEAN, BROTHER?
I AM YOUR LITTLE BROTHER, ONE-EIGHT!
The mysterious silver robot… was in fact One-Eight, One-Seven's younger brother! Is One-Eight friend or foe!?
LITTLE BROTHER… ONE-EIGHT…
BIG BROTHER… ONE-SEVEN…
ONE-EIGHT, FIGHT BRAIN!
BROTHER, RETURN TO BRAIN!
NO! BRAIN IS EVIL…
NO! BRAIN IS RIGHT…
ONE-EIGHT! YOU ARE WRONG.
NO! YOU ARE WRONG!
ONE-EIGHT! YOUR BROTHER IS RIGHT.

Hahaha…

The traitor is One-Seven! Your little brother One-Eight is absolutely loyal to Mister Brain! Heh heh heh…
ONE-EIGHT, COME WITH YOUR BROTHER!
One-Seven! If you don't want to be destroyed, you'd better come back to Brain…
One-Eight, Brain's orders! Finish him!
BROTHER, STOP DEFYING BRAIN.
LITTLE BROTHER… I DO NOT WANT TO FIGHT YOU!
BRAIN'S ORDERS… I WILL DESTROY BROTHER!
STOP! LITTLE BROTHER…
BRAIN'S ORDERS! ONE-EIGHT OBEYS.

Braaavooo!

That's the way, One-Eight! You outperform One-Seven in every way!

Go ahead and destroy him! Smash him! Smash him to pieces!
BROTHER, GO BACK TO BRAIN!
LITTLE BROTHER… YOU ARE WRONG.
ONE-EIGHT IS RIGHT!

Goddaaamn…! One-Eight, after him! Don't let him escape!

Mach Seven, Mach Seven! Catch him and smash him to bits!
One-Seven attacked Chief Kitakura? Is that really true, Dr. Sahara!?
Apparently that's what Chief Kitakura has been saying in her delirium.
One-Seven was in the One-Seven Cave, in terrible shape.
Is that true?
One-Seven wouldn't do something like that!
If so, then who on earth…?

Mister Brain!

One-Eight is magnificent. One-Seven couldn't lay a finger on him! Superb! Veeery goood!

Naturally, Hustler. One-Eight is Brain's finest masterpiece.

What's more… he has no conscience like One-Seven's!
No conscience? Now that's fine work!

More importantly, Hustler… the details of Project B have come to light!

Project B is a plan by the Red Muffler Squad to develop computer control.

I see it now! They intend to use it to control you, Mister Brain?

Hmph… There's no way they could pull off something so stupid!
Project B is flawless… Destroy it while you still can, Hustler…
Understood, Mister Brain…
We too shall support robot commander Professor Hustler!

Hmph, no need! I have One-Eight!

But, well… if you insist on helping, I don't mind, whippersnapper…
Apfaron… I'm worried about leaving it to Hustler alone! You will support him.
Nngh… Do as you please!
Hey, you who saved my life! Won't you show yourself?
Amazing… You're the one who saved me, aren't you?
I AM ONE-EIGHT! YOU, FRIEND…

One-Eight? Will you be my friend?

Then… please find my missing mom! I'm sure she's alive somewhere.

uncertain: One-Seven / One-Eight speak in katakana in the Japanese; rendered in capitals with simple robotic phrasing.
U10188: the robot is One-Eight (revealed later); Yazaki mistakes it for Saburo's One-Seven ("you're Saburo's…").
U10193/U10194: same line with different honorifics (-san vs -chan/-kun); both rendered the same.
U10196: the Naager reference is odd since U10189 reports Gigants; translated as written.
U10202: 見間違うことだって? as "she could have been mistaken, couldn't she?"
U10232: カッ飛ばせ (baseball cheer "knock it out") rendered as "Smash him!"
U10248: Brain says 完璧 "flawless" about the enemy plan, which is why it must be destroyed now.
